runtimeFlags: whole model on the Arc B390 iGPU (ov-genai engine, device GPU, greedy, batch 1); Windows GPU shared-memory window raised to SystemPartitionCommitLimitPercentage=85 (26 GiB per-process budget)
notes: One ASUS NUC: Core Ultra X7 358H, Arc B390 iGPU, 32 GB (31.5 GB usable), Windows 11. OpenVINO INT4 export of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (18 GB) held entirely in GPU shared memory. decodeTps is the medium prompt (975 tokens after the chat template, 256 generated, temperature 0, thinking off) averaged over 3 timed repeats after 1 warm-up: (completion tokens - 1) / (request wall time - time to first token), where TTFT is a separate max_tokens=1 request; ttftMs is the same medium prompt's median. Decode drew 33.5 W package power (0.91 tok/J); output byte-identical to the same model on a 64 GB box over 6 parity prompts. The GPU window matters: at the driver default of 57% the same box oversubscribes the GPU and decodes at 1.7 tok/s.
